## Review

- [ ] Followed `AGENTS.md` and applicable directory instructions when using an agent.
- [ ] Calculations are separate from rendering; reverse scrubbing is deterministic.
- [ ] Every new claim has a source and every asset has a compatible license and credit.
- [ ] The story explains what changed, why, and what to try.
- [ ] Keyboard, touch, reduced motion, and readable fallback still work.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] No unsupported accuracy, reviewer, performance, or user-research claims.
